summary: Iteration 14 - TASCK Opportunity Tracker v3.3 backend + frontend regression. Backend: 9/10 pytest cases PASS (pipeline-counts shape, candidate filter, default hide of dismissed_auto, scan response shape with pass1_rejected/auto_dismissed/candidate_count, candidate v3.3 schema fields, transitions reviewing -> outreach_sent -> meeting_booked with timestamps, won-count update after accept). 1 FAILED: accept against an EXISTING seeded brand does NOT populate Family A fields (key_marketing_focus, primary_target_audience, key_marketing_channels, marketing_kpis, desired_relationship_status='Project Identified - Move to Framing', brand_type, likelihood_to_work_with_tta). The handler creates these only on the new-brand branch (lines 2761-2784 of v3_routes.py); the else-branch (existing brand match by slug) just optionally inserts a contact. Frontend: counter bar with all 4 tabs + Won toggle, default 'new' active, V33Card with signal pill, two-score 'N / N' badge, source link, no 'Not found' text anywhere, Brand Context only shows the four CRM-named rows, forbidden invented sections (Partnership Status / Open calls / PR contact / Press contact) absent, View draft email toggle expands the draft block, action buttons per tab correct, accept auto-navigates to /v3/admin/business-cases/{bc_id} showing Connector AI Extraction section with the Pass-2 intelligence (Key Marketing Focus + Primary Target Audience populated; Key Marketing Channels + Marketing KPIs render as 'Pending' as a direct visible consequence of the existing-brand merge bug above). Lineage / stated intent text is populated. No regressions observed on BC detail Connector tab.

critical.issue: Existing-brand merge path does not apply Family A fields. When the candidate's partner_name slug matches an existing brand (e.g. seeded 'Coca-Cola Nigeria Limited'), the brand record is reused unchanged - key_marketing_focus, primary_target_audience, key_marketing_channels, marketing_kpis, desired_relationship_status, likelihood_to_work_with_tta, brand_type are never written. Spec requires Family A on the brand record regardless of new/existing.

Does NOT wipe v3_opportunity_candidates or v3_opportunity_scans collections (they are not in get_v3_seed_data()). After repeated scans the Tracker page becomes stale and 'won' counts persist across resets. Add these two collections to the reset list (or include empty seed lists).

minor.issue: When existing brand already has a contact, no new 'Stranger' contact is inserted. Spec implies each accepted opportunity should mark the discovered point-of-contact as Stranger - consider always adding/updating connect_status='Stranger' on the matched contact.

integration_issues.issue: Key Marketing Channels and Marketing KPIs render 'Pending' for existing-brand accepts because the backend skipped Family A propagation. Root cause is the backend bug above; UI is correctly displaying whatever the brand record contains.

action_items: [HIGH] In /app/backend/v3_routes.py accept_opportunity_candidate, mirror the Family A field block (key_marketing_focus, primary_target_audience, key_marketing_channels, marketing_kpis, likelihood_to_work_with_tta, brand_type, desired_relationship_status='Project Identified - Move to Framing') into the existing-brand else-branch via a db.v3_brands.update_one($set=...). Optionally only overwrite when current value is empty/null so manual edits stick.

[HIGH] In reset_demo, also wipe v3_opportunity_candidates and v3_opportunity_scans (and any other tracker-side collections) - either add them to get_v3_seed_data() with empty lists or hard-code an extra delete_many for them. Otherwise repeated runs leave stale candidates and the 'won' counter never returns to 0.

[MED] On existing-brand accept, set connect_status='Stranger' on the primary contact (even if a contact already exists) so the spec invariant 'every freshly-accepted opportunity surfaces a Stranger contact' holds.
critical_code_review_comments: v3_routes.py:2745 accept_opportunity_candidate spans ~200 lines and forks heavily on new-vs-existing brand. Consider refactoring into _upsert_brand_from_candidate() so Family A propagation cannot silently diverge between branches (this is the root cause of the current bug).
reset_demo iterates seed.keys() only; safer pattern is an explicit list of all v3_* collections (or db.list_collection_names with a prefix) so future tracker collections cannot be forgotten.

Pass-1 deterministic filter rejected 8/9 of a Coca-Cola query - correct behaviour per spec but worth surfacing the rejection reasons (e.g. in scan summary) so an RM can sanity-check the filter isn't too aggressive when scans return 0 candidates.

OpportunityTransitionPayload regex allows 'new' but the route doesn't strip outreach_sent_at/meeting_booked_at timestamps when stepping back to 'new' or 'reviewing'. Minor - in practice nobody walks backward, but timestamps become misleading if they do.
Frontend uses fetch() directly (not v3api.js wrapper) for pipeline-counts and transition - works but inconsistent with the rest of the codebase, harder to mock in unit tests later.

To clear stale tracker state between runs, run: python -c 'import asyncio,os; from motor.motor_asyncio import AsyncIOMotorClient; c=AsyncIOMotorClient(os.environ["MONGO_URL"]); db=c[os.environ["DB_NAME"]]; asyncio.run(db.v3_opportunity_candidates.delete_many({})); asyncio.run(db.v3_opportunity_scans.delete_many({}))' (or fix the reset-demo per action items). rca of the issue: accept_opportunity_candidate (v3_routes.py:2745-2812) has two branches: (1) NEW brand - lines 2759-2797 build the brand dict with all Family A fields, insert it, and create a Stranger contact; (2) EXISTING brand - lines 2798-2812 only optionally add a contact if none exists, and never updates the brand record. So whenever a scanned candidate's partner_name slug matches a seeded brand (very likely in this demo since Coca-Cola Nigeria, Guinness, MTN etc. are all seeded), the discovery Pass-2 enrichment never lands on the brand record. Reproduction: reset-demo -> POST /opportunities/scans with query 'Coca-Cola Nigeria campaign launch' -> accept the returned candidate -> GET /brands -> 'Coca-Cola Nigeria Limited' has no key_marketing_focus / primary_target_audience / key_marketing_channels / marketing_kpis / desired_relationship_status. Mitigation: after `brand = next(...)` lookup, when found, run `await db.v3_brands.update_one({'id': brand['id']}, {'$set': {Family A fields, only overwriting when None/empty}})` and refetch brand before continuing to BC creation.
